1: TOWN OF SHARPSBURG, GEORGIA PREAMBLE AN ORDINANCE OF THE TOWN OF SHARPSBURG, GEORGIA WHEREAS, the Mayor and Town Council of the Town of Sharpsburg adopted a new and comprehensive zoning map for the Town of Sharpsburg on October 2, 2006; and WHEREAS, the Mayor of the Town of Sharpsburg has caused to be prepared a new and comprehensive zoning map for the Town of Sharpsburg, which map designates the location and boundaries ofthe Town's zoning districts: and WHEREAS, the Town Council believes that said zoning map provides a clear and comprehensive mechanism whereby members of the public may easily determine the location and boundaries of the zoning districts: and WHEREAS, the Town Council of the Town of Sharpsburg desires to adopt said zoning map as the Official Zoning Map for the Town of Sharpsburg; and WHEREAS, the Town of Sharpsburg desires to protect the health, safety, morals, and welfare of the citizens ofthe Town of Sharpsburg; NOW THEREFORE, The Mayor and the Council 0f the Town of Sharpsburg hereby ENACT and ORDAIN the Town of Sharpsburgs Zoning Map Ordinance as follows:
